title: Anvil shared definitions (schema version 1)
description: Shared scalar definitions for the Anvil event and recording contract, version 1. See docs/architecture.md (Storage and versioning).

schemaVersion.description: Contract version pin. Only "1" is defined; any other value MUST be rejected explicitly.

uuidv7.description: UUID version 7 identifier (time-ordered). The version nibble MUST be 7.

traceId.description: Original OpenTelemetry trace ID (32 lowercase hex characters).

spanId.description: Original OpenTelemetry span ID (16 lowercase hex characters).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with milliseconds and UTC offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T12:00:00.123Z.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters. Artifacts and recordings carry SHA-256 hashes.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer ("" or a /-separated path).

eventType.description: Closed set of event types for schema version 1 (docs/architecture.md).

captureCompleteness.description: Capture completeness state. Distinct from execution outcome.

executionOutcome.description: Execution outcome state. Distinct from capture completeness.
